dialogues.speaker: Arkhyp
dialogues.text: Haha, just talking to myself here. It's about my daughter, Lyulka. She tinkers with her little kuuvahki gadgets, day in and day out. She even borrowed my workshop for it.

dialogues.speaker: Arkhyp
dialogues.text: I can't understand how those things work at all, but seeing as how she's so invested in them... As her old man, all I can do is to leave her to it.
